item.title: When the Parent Palace Activates, Is It Paperwork or Elders First?
item.description: An activated Parent Palace often raises approvals, paperwork, and household rules before it clearly turns into an elder-care event. Separate the institutional line from the family line early.

item.title: A Good Annual Cycle With No Result Yet? Check Which Palace Was Actually Lit Up
item.description: An annual cycle can be favorable without rewarding the exact life area you were watching. Start by checking whether the activated palace matches the question you care about.

item.title: Read Responsibility Before Industry in the Career Palace
item.description: The Career Palace works better as a responsibility map than a job-title catalog. Industry and title usually come after role, authority, and work structure are separated.

item.title: In a Crowded Palace, Read the Main Star Before the Transformations
item.description: A crowded palace becomes clearer when the main star names the operating pattern first, the Four Transformations mark emphasis second, and support or friction comes later.
